content.text:
I removed the four CSS rules in `index.html` that coloured each todo by priority. Todos no longer get priority colours, so the overdue highlight is the only colour cue. You can still set a priority when adding a todo, lists still sort by priority, and the priority checks pass.

I didn't add a text label in place of the colours, so a todo's priority now shows only in its sort position; say if you want a label.
